title: Private Deployments: Preboard Security & Hardware Checklist
content:
Purpose:

This is a focused preboarding checklist for hires joining the Private Deployments squad (VPC / on-prem work). The doc is intended for People Ops + Eng leads to ensure new hires have the hardware, credentials, and security context needed to be productive in their first 72 hours. It is intentionally pragmatic: mix of logistics, security approvals, and lightweight runbook fragments.

Scope and assumptions:
- Role types covered: software engineer (infra/serving), SRE, solutions engineer for private deployments.
- Paperwork (offer, background check) is handled separately; this checklist starts once offer accepted and candidate has confirmed start date.
- Customers and regulatory constraints (air-gapped, HIPAA, SOC2) should be annotated per hire in the role ticket (JIRA-4121).

72-hour orientation goals (high level):
1) Day 0–1: hardware and access in place (asset assigned, VPN + bastion access, SSO + GitHub access).
2) Day 1–2: minimal end-to-end deploy test on a non-production private environment (deploy sample model or container).
3) Day 2–3: security onboarding complete (KMS/HSM orientation, audit logs, secrets handling review), and first shadow run with a senior engineer.

Preboard checklist (action items owner in parentheses):

1) Hardware & Assets
- Confirm hardware profile needed (server vs laptop, required GPUs, NICs) and reserve (people-ops / eng ops).
- Reserve rack space / bench time for on-prem hires with facilities (eng-ops).
- Create asset ticket with serial numbers, warranty, and vendor RMA info (eng-ops).
- Pre-flash and image the node with standard base image (image-tag: redwood-pd-ubuntu-2025-08) and attach to candidate asset ticket (release-engineering).
- Inventory: asset tag, serial, MAC, warranty expiry, RAID config (list actual values in ticket).
- Ship logistics: pickup window, recipient name, shipping tracking, and UPS customs paperwork if APAC (people-ops logistics).

2) Network & Physical Access
- Ensure building badge / desk access / parking passes issued for on-site hires (people-ops / facilities).
- Pre-provision VLAN and ensure default firewall rules have a test path to build/bench network (infrastructure).
- Register MAC address and IP reservation for assigned node; add to change-runbook (platform-engineering).
- If air-gapped: provide media drop instructions and secure courier contact (solutions-eng).

3) Identity, Auth, and Secrets
- Create SSO account and add to groups: rhd-private-deploy, slack-private-deploy, github-private (people-ops / security).
- Provision VPN access and MFA device (Okta + YubiKey if required) — record issuance (security).
- Create short-lived deployment keys and service account for initial test deploy; store reference in ticket (eng-serving-runtime).
- Add to KMS policy read-only initially; escalate to encrypt/decrypt after shadow session (security).

4) Access to Code and Deploy Tooling
- Add to repo permissions (github org/team mapping) and add to CI mirror access for private deployment pipelines (developer-experience).
- Give access to console + private control plane staging environment (console-and-tooling) and add route + model permissions.
- Share PR templates, deploy runbook link, and a small sample deployment template under a personal test org (linked in linked_artifacts).

5) Security Orientation & Compliance
- Schedule a 60-minute security walkthrough during day 1 covering: handling of customer data, KMS/HSM usage, audit log locations, incident reporting flow, and LLM output egress controls (security).
- Provide checklist for forbidden actions in private environments (no external USBs, no unapproved snapshot uploads).
- Require signed acknowledgement of the private-deployment NDA addendum where applicable (people-ops/legal).

6) First-Run Playbook (minimal E2E test)
- Steps: 1) SSH to bastion via VPN, 2) pull sample private-deploy repo, 3) run infra-setup script (scripts/setup-priv-test.sh), 4) run deploy sample-model.sh to a test slot, 5) hit /health endpoint and run an inference request with 10 tokens.
- Acceptance: process completes without secrets-in-cleartext, logs are emitted to private log collector, and the deployment is tagged with candidate github username.

7) Shadow / Mentorship pairing
- Pair hire with assigned mentor for first 2 weeks; schedule 2x 1-hour shadow sessions in first 5 days (mentors: Lina Sørensen).
- Create a lightweight 7-task onboarding playbook in their GitHub checklist for first 14 days (developer-experience).

Operational notes and quick references:
- Common tickets to link: JIRA-4121 (role ticket), JIRA-4330 (bench reservation), JIRA-4458 (KMS policy request).
- Slack channels: #priv-deploy-onboard (for logistics), #priv-deploy-ops (technical questions).
- Confluence pages: CONF-priv-deploy-preboard (canonical preboard runbook), CONF-airgap-handling (air-gap SOP).

Escalation matrix (who to ping first):
- Hardware failure (under warranty): Diego Marquez (eng-ops) -> vendor RMA -> people-ops for replacement coordination.
- Network provisioning delays: Network on-call -> platform eng lead.
- Secrets/KMS issues: Security on-call -> infra-sec engineer.

Acceptance criteria for 72-hour window (explicit):
- Physical asset delivered, powered on, and visible in inventory with correct tags.
- SSO + VPN + bastion access validated by candidate (screenshot or terminal logs).
- Candidate completed minimal E2E test and added a short PR that documents their test run and artifacts.
- Security walkthrough completed and ack recorded.

Open questions / decisions to make:
- Should hires get temporary elevated KMS rights for the test deploy or rely on the mentor to run the critical encrypt/decrypt steps? (security decision pending)
- Standard laptop vs server-assigned policy for remote-only hires who still need private-deploy lab access.

Next steps (owners):
- People Ops: finalize shipping label and confirm delivery window (due: two business days before start).
- Eng Ops: pre-image node and stash service account keys in sealed vault (due: 3 days before start).
- Security: pre-schedule 60-minute walkthrough and add to candidate calendar (due: day 1 morning).

Notes to self (informal):
- Keep this checklist lean. Some hires only need partial items (support/solutions vs infra engineers). Add a short role mapping table when time permits.
- Save a small binary snapshot of the base image in releases bucket to speed future prep.

Links / sample commands (copyable):
- ssh: ssh -A candidate@bastion.redwood.internal - follow buddy pairing notes
- test deploy script: ./scripts/deploy-sample-priv.sh --env=staging --model=sample-smallgpt
- check logs: curl -u $CI_TOKEN: "https://private-logs.redwood.internal/logs?asset=<asset-id>"

Document history:
- Created: 2025-10-02 by Aisha Patel
- Last updated: 2025-10-07 — added acceptance criteria and open questions

If anything breaks in the preboard flow, open JIRA with label preboard-failure and tag people-ops + eng-ops for triage.
